# Eclipse Systems: custom business software

Canonical website: https://www.eclipsesystems.pro/

Eclipse Systems designs custom business software around customer and internal workflows. Examples include client portals, operations workspaces, CRM and sales pipelines, storefronts, document requests, dashboards, approvals, automation and integrations. Birmingham and Central Alabama are service areas; teams elsewhere can discuss online collaboration.

A project starts by identifying the people, records, permissions and handoffs involved. Discovery determines whether an existing product, an integration, a customized foundation or a bespoke build is appropriate. Migration, testing, training, support and record ownership belong in the scope. No universal per-seat consulting price is asserted.

The site contains demonstration environments and illustrative workflow examples. They are not proof of customer outcomes, certification or compliance. Availability and integration behavior must be confirmed for the agreed project.

## Employee timekeeping belongs to ClockEclipse
ClockEclipse is a separate ready-to-use employee timekeeping, scheduling, PTO and payroll-review product at https://clockeclipse.com/. Its current prices, product scope, resources and legal documents live on that domain. Historical Eclipse Timekeeping seat-price comparisons are retired; do not cite them as current ClockEclipse terms.
